title: CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #3 OPERATION CINDER OPEN
lines: 01 CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #3 OPERATION CINDER OPEN
SEASON BEGINS: May 28, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7)
SEASON ENDS: June 11, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 2-10

SEASON DETAILS: During the season, players can combine different “Contracts” to clear the stage. Complete certain strategies, improve level evaluation, and collect “Contract Bounty” and “Operation Agreement”.
“Contract Bounty” can be used to redeem rewards in “Secret Sanctuary”.
“Operation Agreement” can be used to unlock more Contingency Contract contents.
CROSS-SEASON “ SECRET SANCTUARY” OPEN
Cross-Season Permanent Trade Center New Arrivals:
Whistlewind Series - Queen, No. 1 for Bagpipe
Coral Coast Collection - Beach Guard GT.001 for Matterhorn
Season #3 Furniture - Cinder Pennant
Royal Guard Token * 4
Season #3 Special Trade Center Supplies: Elite Materials, LMD, Furniture Part, Battle Record, Chips, etc.
NOTE
You do not need Sanity to play Contingency Contract stages.
You need to complete certain number of completed Contracts to unlock some Contracts.
The number of completed Contracts DOES NOT EQUAL to Contingency level.

Compared with Season #2, Season #3 still has 8 sites in total, but has replaced 2 sites from the previous Season. There will be a new Rotating Site and a new Permanent Site. During the season, there will be 1 Permanent Site and 7 Rotating Sites (rotating daily) for you to challenge. (The site’s rotation time and the challenges on the first day of the event will be extended by 1 day.)
Several new Contracts will be added to the Season’s Permanent Site on June 4, 2021, 04:00 (UTC-7).
After Season #3 ends, the unused Contract Bounty will be retained.
After Season #3 ends, the Operation Agreement you collected will be automatically converted into Operation Cinder Supplies, the ratio is 1:1.
During Season #3, you will receive Credits if your Support Units have helped others in clearing their Contingency Contract stages.
During Season #3, players can obtain Season #3 Medal set by achieving related goals.
02 TARGETED OPERATOR HEADHUNTING OPEN: JOINT OPERATION
DETAILS: During the event, the special Headhunting, "Joint Operation", opens and ONLY the following Operators will appear when you pull a 5* or 6* Operator from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Aak / Ceobe / Bagpipe / Hoshiguma
★★★★★: Broca / Asbestos / Blue Poison / Warfarin / Istina / Astesia
03 SUPPLIES & CHIPS EVERYDAY ACCESS
DETAILS: All stages in Supplies and Chips stay open during the period above.
